company.name: SeedLegals
company.shortDescription: The simple way for companies to complete the legals needed to raise investment and distribute equity
company.description:
Start, raise and grow faster with SeedLegals. 

We're the platform that automates the legals to help companies close funding rounds faster, hire, manage, allocate equity to their team and more...

We're the operating system for your company. And we've already transformed the way more than 15,000 UK and French startups run their businesses.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform that automates the creation, customization, sharing, signing, and storage of legal documents for startups and small businesses.
productsAndServices.name: Legal Document Automation Platform

productsAndServices.description: A service to facilitate startup fundraising by generating compliant legal documents, managing cap tables, and supporting SEIS/EIS tax relief compliance.
productsAndServices.name: Funding Round Management

productsAndServices.description: A service to create and manage employee share option schemes, including EMI and unapproved schemes, with legal documentation and valuations.
productsAndServices.name: Share Option Schemes Management

productsAndServices.description: A service to help startups and SMEs claim Research and Development tax credits by preparing and submitting claims with expert support.
productsAndServices.name: R&D Tax Credits Service

productsAndServices.description: A subscription service providing startups with access to dedicated senior lawyers for on-demand legal advice on commercial contracts, employment law, IP strategy, and data privacy.
productsAndServices.name: General Counsel as a Service (GCaaS)

productsAndServices.description: A digital tool to manage company equity, shareholders, share classes, share transfers, and related corporate governance documents.
productsAndServices.name: Cap Table and Shareholder Management

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $4,000,000, or 75.4% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,992,654 to $24,821,864, a 3.55x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
